description: BOISE, Idaho — Governor Brad Little signed Executive Order 2026-05 today establishing the State Workforce Pell Coordinating Council (SWPCC), marking the next phase of Idaho’s implementation of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act and expanding opportunities for Idahoans to gain the skills they need for high-demand careers.
